info.title: SDAI Blog
info.description: Published release notes, announcements, and engineering articles shared by the website and mobile reader.

get.description: Downloads the complete feed in reverse chronological order for browsing and offline reading.

schema.description: All published articles and their metadata.

Blog.description: All website blog articles in reverse chronological order.

posts.description: Published posts in display order. Empty when the website has no posts.

BlogPost.description: One published article with metadata and full body.

slug.description: Stable article identifier derived from the website path.

summary.description: Short article description for the feed list.

publishedOn.description: Calendar date when the article was published.

category.description: Publisher-assigned category displayed beside the date.

url.description: Canonical HTTPS article address used for sharing.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS address of the article cover on the publication host.

coverDescription.description: Alternative text describing the cover artwork.

markdown.description: Complete GitHub-flavored Markdown article, excluding YAML front matter.
